component.name: DriveCraft
component.summary: Sync your cloud files with a folder

description.p: Replace the official apps of OneDrive, Dropbox, Box, and more with one light, private, open source app. DriveCraft sends no telemetry, and puts no server of its own between your computer and your cloud.
DriveCraft keeps real copies of your cloud files in a folder on your computer, and syncs them in both directions. You select the folders that sync. The other folders stay only online.

ul.li: More than one account at a time. Each account syncs to a folder of its own in ~/DriveCraft.
A switch for each folder: on, it syncs to this computer; off, it stays only online.
After a sign-in, nothing downloads until you select the folders and start the first sync.
A missing folder stops the sync, so it cannot delete your files online.
A file that changed on both sides keeps both versions.

description.p: For the sync, DriveCraft uses rclone, a tool that people trust with their files for more than ten years. DriveCraft includes rclone. You sign in on the website of your cloud, in your browser.

screenshot.caption: Select the folders that sync to this computer
Each file that a sync changed

ul.li: DriveCraft starts when you sign in to the computer. You can turn this off in Settings.
Only one DriveCraft runs at a time. A second start shows the window of the running DriveCraft.
Windows: an installer for your user, with a shortcut in the Start menu.
Linux: a desktop file, an icon, and AppStream metadata.
Flatpak: DriveCraft finds the folders of other cloud clients, and moves a folder to the Trash of the system.

description.p: A click on the tray icon hides the window when the window is in front.
